models.name: multi_user_todo_user_profiles
models.description: Stores a user's private profile personalization details. The profile is owned by exactly one user account, and other users must not be able to view it.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key for the user profile record.

foreignFields.name: multi_user_todo_user_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the owning {@link multi_user_todo_user_profiles.id} account. Enforces that each user has at most one profile.

plainFields.name: display_name
plainFields.description: User-facing display name presented in the app. This is a key profile attribute used for personalization.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Record last update timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp. When set, the profile is treated as deleted and is no longer visible to the owning user.

models.name: multi_user_todo_todos
models.description: Private task item owned by exactly one user and visible only to that user across normal, completed, and trash states. Stores the todo's current editable attributes plus timestamps for filtering, ordering, and soft deletion visibility.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key of the todo item.

plainFields.name: title
plainFields.description: Required human-readable title of the todo.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Optional longer description for the todo; can be empty or null.

plainFields.name: start_date
plainFields.description: Optional datetime indicating when the todo begins.

plainFields.name: due_date
plainFields.description: Optional datetime deadline for the todo.

plainFields.name: is_complete
plainFields.description: Completion status of the todo; starts as false (incomplete).

plainFields.name: lifecycle_state
plainFields.description: Lifecycle state controlling deletion flow and list visibility (e.g., normal vs trash).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Creation timestamp of the todo record.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update timestamp of the todo record.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft-delete timestamp. When non-null, the todo is considered deleted (typically moved to trash) and excluded from normal lists.

models.name: multi_user_todo_todo_edit_history_entries
models.description:
Immutable edit history entry for a specific todo.

Each row represents a single change event and stores both the previous and new values for tracked todo attributes. This enables audit-style inspection of how a user's todo changed over time, ordered most-recent to oldest via edit_made_at and the created_at timestamps.

Entries are soft-deletable, and are permanently removed when the owning todo is permanently removed per system retention rules.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key for the todo edit history entry.

foreignFields.name: multi_user_todo_todo_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to {@link multi_user_todos.id} for the todo that was edited.

foreignFields.name: multi_user_todo_owner_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the owning user of the edited todo, copied for efficient ownership-scoped filtering.

plainFields.name: edit_made_at
plainFields.description: Business time when the edit was made.

plainFields.name: previous_title
plainFields.description: Previous todo title value before this edit.

plainFields.name: new_title
plainFields.description: New todo title value after this edit.

plainFields.name: previous_description
plainFields.description: Previous todo description value before this edit; null means it was empty.

plainFields.name: new_description
plainFields.description: New todo description value after this edit; null means it is empty.

plainFields.name: previous_start_date
plainFields.description: Previous todo start date before this edit; null means it was unset.

plainFields.name: new_start_date
plainFields.description: New todo start date after this edit; null means it is unset.

plainFields.name: previous_due_date
plainFields.description: Previous todo due date before this edit; null means it was unset.

plainFields.name: new_due_date
plainFields.description: New todo due date after this edit; null means it is unset.

plainFields.name: previous_is_complete
plainFields.description: Previous completion status before this edit.

plainFields.name: new_is_complete
plainFields.description: New completion status after this edit.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Record last update timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp for this history entry.
